pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Bubba G drafted DR Congo like he's gettin' secret tactics from his dog's psychic, but Bubba's got France takin' on Devin's Spain today, right in my home state of Texas. France's been grindin' out results like a team that knows how to put on a show, sittin' pretty for Bubba G at the top of the standings with a whole 81 points. Now, Ghost Pepper Devin's clingy to Spain like they’re gonna sprinkle magic paella dust and bring him up from second place. But I reckon Gunner's gonna ride that French flair all the way to the winner's circle like he's draftin' with a four-leaf clover stuck in his boot. Mark my words: les Bleus are takin' the W, and Ghost Pepper's gonna be left wonderin' if spicy’s all he's got to bring to this table.
